chain.text: The depot holds 62 vehicles. The depot employs 140 drivers. The depot was certified in June 2023. The maintenance bay holds 8 lifts. Certification renewal was due in June 2028. Halvard Onstad is the operations lead. Teodora Blaskovic supervises the night shift. Daily departures average 410. The winter peak reached 530 departures. Cancellations run at 1.8 percent. In February 2025, nine vehicles were grounded four days. Every vehicle requires a brake check every 6000 kilometres. In September 2024, the fuel card system was cloned. 4200 euros were lost before notice. Fuel cards need second approval above 200 euros. Route changes need seven days' notice. Incident reports require filing within 24 hours. The electrification study is approved but unfunded. The second charging bay is scheduled for the third quarter. The old ticketing terminal remains on three routes. The night shift is not fully staffed. The February failure cause is not established.
